query:
SELECT 
  CASE attendeeId 
    WHEN '9322701' THEN 'Tush Wijeratne (WPP)'
    WHEN '174442448959' THEN 'Joanna Hackett (Howden)'
    WHEN '93176107633' THEN 'Mark Kunaseelan (UAL)'
    WHEN '8196151' THEN 'Michelle Monahan (Eur Tyre)'
    WHEN '91889321035' THEN 'Lucy Bousfield (Aon)'
  END as delegateName,
  m.timeSlot,
  s.companyName as sponsor,
  m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId IN ('9322701','174442448959','93176107633','8196151','91889321035')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
